name: Deckio
description: Smart flashcards with SM-2 spaced repetition, auto-generated quizzes, timed review and analytics. FastAPI + Next.js 16 — try the live in-browser demo.

paragraphs: A lightweight, product-focused flashcards platform: manage decks, practice with flip-card study sessions, take auto-generated multiple-choice quizzes, and track learning progress — exposed through a clean REST API and bundled with a polished web client.
features: 🔐 JWT authentication — register / login, bcrypt-hashed passwords, bearer-token sessions, brute-force rate limiting on credential endpoints
👤 Account management — password change (re-verifies current) and self-service account deletion with cascade cleanup
🗂 Deck management — CRUD with color accents, emoji icons, search, sorting, live stats, one-click duplication (cards copied, SRS progress reset)

🃏 Flashcards — CRUD per deck, free-form tags (max 8/card), optional hints (memory aids shown before flipping), optional images (rendered on both faces in study mode), plus CSV bulk import & export (delimiter…
🔎 Global search (⌘K) — command palette searching decks, card text and tags, with quick actions
